dict.string: Meeting Recorder reads your Calendar to surface upcoming meetings, auto-tag recordings to the right client, and generate pre-meeting briefs from prior sessions on the same calendar.
Meeting Recorder reads your Calendar to surface upcoming meetings, auto-tag recordings to the right client, and generate pre-meeting briefs from prior sessions on the same calendar.
Meeting Recorder needs microphone access to record your side of the conversation. The mic stream is processed locally; nothing is sent off-device unless you've enabled cloud transcription.
Meeting Recorder uses Apple Events to draft follow-up emails in Mail.app or Outlook for Mac after a recording finishes. You'll be prompted the first time it tries to talk to the email app.
